title: Juicy Syrian Potato Tagine
description: A sour and tender Syrian dish featuring yukon gold potatoes in a miso marinade, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This paleo-friendly recipe is cooked to perfection in a claypot.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, lemon juice, and olive oil to make the marinade.
Add the cubed potatoes to the marinade and toss to coat.
Heat the claypot over medium heat and add the minced garlic, cooking for 1 minute.
Add the marinated potatoes to the claypot, stirring to combine with the garlic.
Add the salt, black pepper, and sumac to the claypot, stirring to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Cover the claypot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 30 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes.
Remove the claypot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
